Add to Stremio✕
Add my released movie & series lists to Stremio as catalogs that stay in sync. Install everything, or pick just the lists you want. No account needed.
▶ Install all lists⚙️ Choose which lists →
  1. Install all lists — one click, everything included (or copy the link above for web Stremio).
  2. Choose which lists — tick the lists you want and set their order, then install from there.
  3. In Stremio, open Discover — the lists appear as catalogs.
